subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should preset session marks be a sponsored core command, or an optional plugin using an expanded generic plugin-command menu contract?
rationale: The patch splits one command between core discovery/UI and plugin execution, and automation cannot choose the permanent public API and product ownership boundary.

options.title: Keep It Plugin-Owned
options.body: Add generic argument and menu metadata to loaded plugin commands and keep mark state and execution inside the plugin without core imports.

options.title: Adopt It In Core
options.body: Replace the plugin bridge with a normal core session command and core-owned structured state, lifecycle coverage, and documentation.

options.title: Decline The Feature
options.body: Close the PR if preset session marks do not justify a new command or plugin API surface.

recommendation.title: Keep It Plugin-Owned
recommendation.body: Add generic argument and menu metadata to loaded plugin commands and keep mark state and execution inside the plugin without core imports.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the core/plugin product boundary and command API direction, for which the repository ownership trail points most strongly to steipete.
